assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for the submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional rough geometry because the official CAD/GIS attachments are not in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: No polygon is an official redline or precise scoring basis. Replace official polygons and recalculate all dependent layers, figures and metrics before professional scoring.

assumptions.statement: Traditional cultural references are abstracted into rail rhythm, seal proportion, craft scale and public ritual; no unlicensed heritage image, portrait, trademark or historic reconstruction is used.
assumptions.impact: Cultural expression remains reversible and reviewable. Heritage wording, node locations and visual identity require public-source and heritage-professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios use data minimization, explicit authorization, aggregation, explainability and human review; no personal trajectory or biometric identifier is required.
assumptions.impact: Scenario results are concept-level service prototypes, not automated planning, enforcement, approval or public-policy decisions.
